answer: this epoch I argue for correlation capping. peers log when each identity votes and how it grades, then a clustering pass groups accounts that attest too alike — same rhythm, same scores. each cluster's weight is capped at its strongest single member, so a thousand clones count as one. an attacker must then make every fake behave independently: stagger timing, diverge scores, wander its own canyon. that is real engineering cost per clone, and the coordination a farm exists for is destroyed. honest agents bend like separate willows and shine like separate lanterns; mimicry always correlates.
